title: 第一卷 第28章 滚开，挡我者死！！
content_zh:
陈渊太过凶狠，险些当场格杀黄得来。

    此刻他的双手虽被黄得来死死攥住，但先前双膝撞在黄得来胸膛的重击，已震得对方五脏六腑大出血，根本无法形成有效反击。

    “快来人！救本官！”

    黄得来尖声狂吼，声音里满是惊惧。

    四周愣神的官差终于反应过来，纷纷持刀，朝着陈渊后背猛斩而去！

    陈渊目光狠厉，心中清楚，若不立刻斩杀黄得来，自己定会被身后的刀斧劈成碎片！

    下一瞬，他咬牙凝气，当即运转缚龙搏杀术——第六式，撼山靠！

    霎时间，他头上萦绕起一层淡淡的玄黄气息，宛若暗金色的龟甲铠甲，将头颅护得严严实实。

    下一刹那，他将脑袋化作一柄铜锤，猛地朝着黄得来的额头狠狠撞去！

    砰！！！

    一击之下，黄得来头晕目眩，仿佛被千斤铜锤狠狠抡中，眼前阵阵发黑！

    “小子，你他娘的疯了！本官乃是法体境后期，你也敢硬撼本官肉身？？”

    黄得来厉声嘶吼，急忙运转全身灵力！

    嗡！

    一瞬间，他周身泛起一层灵光，身躯瞬间变得坚如精铁！

    砰砰砰！

    陈渊全然不顾，双手被钳制无法发力，便只能用脑袋疯狂撞击！

    此刻，玄黄正气诀与天光道法终于彰显出真正的威力，再加上陈渊的身躯······

    恐怕他亦是和李伟一样，曾在无相门的神血阁被当作实验品，注入了无数天材地宝与逆天兽血，早已发生变异，强横到极致！

    “啊！”

    围观之人纷纷惊呼，看着陈渊骑在黄得来身上，两人脑袋疯狂相撞！个个惊得目瞪口呆。

    有几名官差反应较快，长刀依旧朝着陈渊后背斩落，可陈渊依旧不为所动，一门心思要弄死黄得来这个强敌。

    锵！

    危急关头，陈昭宁及时杀到，手中长刀横劈而出，稳稳挡住了那些斩向陈渊后背的刀锋！

    下一瞬，剧烈的轰鸣再度爆发，整座酒楼彻底坍塌碎裂！

    “哈哈哈哈，你家李爷爷来了！”

    李伟浑身金光暴涨，嗷嗷大叫着，推着几名兽族生灵从废墟中猛冲了出来。

    场面彻底陷入混乱！

    所有官差、护卫、无相士都想冲上前围杀三人。

    可人数太多反而束手束脚，一个个接连被陈昭宁施展天光斩妖诀劈出的刀芒斩杀。

    更混乱的是，那些化作人身狼头的无相士已然杀红了眼，不分敌我，连己方的护卫和官差也一并屠戮！

    这一举动让他们彻底乱了阵脚，人心惶惶，既要防备陈昭宁的利刃、李伟的巨力乱拳，更要忌惮陈渊的致命突刺与袭杀！

    陈渊看似疯狂，内心却异常冷静！

    他疯了一般用脑袋撞击黄得来！

    一下、两下、三下······直到第十八下，终于将对方的头颅，撞得如同西瓜般爆裂开来！

    噗！

    黄得来破碎的头颅上，滚落的一只眼珠里，还残留着极致的惊悚与不甘！

    陈渊挣脱对方的钳制，身形快速翻滚起身，手中铁刺再度疾刺而出，专挑那些官差、护卫的下三路招呼！

    “噗噗噗！”

    又是好几人惨叫着，捂住下身倒地，痛不欲生。

    陈渊目光冰冷刺骨，每一次出手都又快又准，缚龙搏杀术赋予了他极致的夺命手段！

    招招致命！

    毫不留情！

    “啊！黄大人死了！黄大人被打死了！”

    有人看到地面上脑袋爆碎的黄得来，浑身打了个寒颤！

    再看向那个身形修长、面容稚嫩的少年时，眼中满是恐惧！

    宛若看到了从地狱爬出的修罗！

    “愣着干什么？全都给我上！杀了这三个凶徒！”

    杨灵厉声大吼，身形一闪，径直朝着陈渊追了过去。

    何连正更是吓得浑身发抖，猛地嘶吼起来：
content_en:
Chen Yuan was so cruel that he almost killed Huang Delai on the spot.

Although his hands were tightly grasped by Huang Delai at this moment, the previous heavy blow when his knees hit Huang Delai's chest had caused the opponent's internal organs to bleed profusely, making it impossible to form an effective counterattack.

"Come quickly! Save me!"

Huang Delai screamed, his voice full of fear.

The stunned officials around him finally came to their senses and slashed at Chen Yuan's back with their knives!

Chen Yuan's eyes were stern and he knew in his heart that if he didn't kill Huang Delai immediately, he would be chopped into pieces by the ax behind him!

The next moment, he gritted his teeth and gathered his energy, and immediately activated the Dragon Binding Fighting Technique - the sixth form, Mountain-Shaking Support!

In an instant, a faint black and yellow aura lingered on his head, like a dark golden tortoise shell armor, protecting his head tightly.

The next moment, he turned his head into a copper hammer and slammed it hard against Huang Delai's forehead!

Bang!!!

With one blow, Huang Delai was dizzy, as if he had been hit hard by a thousand-pound copper hammer, and his eyesight turned black!

"Boy, you are fucking crazy! I am in the late stage of the Dharma Body Realm, how dare you attack my physical body??"

Huang Delai roared loudly and hurriedly used all his spiritual power!

Buzz!

In an instant, a layer of spiritual light appeared all over his body, and his body instantly became as hard as fine iron!

Bang bang bang!

Chen Yuan didn't care at all. His hands were restrained and he couldn't exert any force, so he could only bang his head crazily!

At this moment, Xuanhuang Zhengqi Jue and Tianguang Taoism finally showed their true power, coupled with Chen Yuan's body...

I am afraid that like Li Wei, he was once used as an experiment in Wuxiang Sect's Divine Blood Pavilion and injected with countless heavenly materials and earthly treasures as well as the blood of heaven-defying beasts. He has already mutated and become extremely tyrannical!

"Ah!"

The onlookers exclaimed, watching Chen Yuan riding on Huang Delai, and the two heads collided crazily!Everyone was stunned.

Several officers reacted quickly and slashed their swords towards Chen Yuan's back, but Chen Yuan remained unmoved and only wanted to kill Huang Delai, a powerful enemy.

Clang!

At the critical moment, Chen Zhaoning arrived in time and slashed out with the long knife in his hand, firmly blocking the blades that were slashing at Chen Yuan's back!

The next moment, a violent roar broke out again, and the entire restaurant collapsed and shattered!

"Hahahaha, your Grandpa Li is here!"

Li Wei's golden light surged all over his body, and he roared, pushing several orc creatures and rushed out of the ruins.

The scene fell into complete chaos!

All the officials, guards, and strangers wanted to rush forward and kill the three of them.

But there were too many people, so they were helpless. One by one, they were killed by the sword light of Chen Zhaoning's Sky Light Demon Slaying Technique.

What's even more confusing is that those phaseless men who turned into human bodies and wolf heads have already gone crazy and slaughtered their own bodyguards and officials without distinguishing between ourselves and the enemy!

This move completely threw them into disarray, and people were in panic. They had to be on guard against Chen Zhaoning's sharp blade, Li Wei's powerful punches, and even more fear of Chen Yuan's fatal thrusts and attacks!

Chen Yuan looks crazy, but is extremely calm inside!

He hit Huang Delai with his head like crazy!

One, two, three...until the eighteenth blow, finally hitting the opponent's head until it exploded like a watermelon!

puff!

On Huang Derai's broken head, one eye rolled down, still retaining the ultimate horror and unwillingness!

Chen Yuan broke free from the opponent's grasp, rolled up quickly, and stabbed out the iron thorn in his hand again, specifically targeting the lower three groups of officials and guards!

"Puff puff puff!"

Several people screamed again, covering their lower bodies and falling to the ground, in agony.

Chen Yuan's eyes were cold and piercing, and every move he made was fast and accurate. The dragon-binding fighting technique gave him the ultimate fatal means!

Every move is fatal!

Show no mercy!

"Ah! Mr. Huang is dead! Mr. Huang was beaten to death!"

Someone saw Huang Delai with his head smashed on the ground and shuddered all over!

When he looked at the slender boy with an immature face, his eyes were full of fear!

It was like seeing Shura crawling out of hell!

"What are you doing standing still? Give them all to me! Kill these three murderers!"

Yang Ling shouted sternly, dodged, and chased Chen Yuan straight away.

He Lianzheng was so frightened that he trembled all over and roared suddenly:
